sections.heading: About this policy
paragraphs: This policy is about the BolCash website, bolcash.in.
The BolCash app is not launched yet. The privacy policy for the app: TODO: verify

sections.heading: What this website does not do
paragraphs: We do not run advertising on this website.
We do not use analytics or tracking tools on this website. If we add them, we will ask for your consent first.
We do not ask you to create an account.

sections.heading: The free tools
paragraphs: The calculators and the reminder message tool run in your browser. What you type stays on your phone. It is not sent to us.

sections.heading: Links to other services
paragraphs: The Google Play button, the WhatsApp share button and the links to official sites take you to other services. Their own privacy policies apply once you leave this site.

sections.heading: Download buttons
paragraphs: The download buttons will tell us which page you came from. This helps us see which pages lead people to the app.
